answer.reason_text: The owner said the updater belongs to the backup tool and agreed to mark it expected for 30 days.

answers_note: Marking a finding expected or seen is the owner's answer: it hides the finding from him. An agent must not give it on the owner's behalf; it may show the owner the command to give it.
title: A program set to start by itself on this Mac was added, changed or removed.
meaning: Normal right after you install, update or remove an app that works in the background.
advice: If you did not, find out which app it belongs to.
